import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    words = data[1:1 + n]
    # the word after the last one wraps around to words[0]
    out = [words[i][0] + words[(i + 1) % n][-1] for i in range(n)]
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")


main()
